verdict.rationale: Khoj does not lock in the user's source data. It indexes files the user already keeps in open formats (markdown, org-mode, plaintext, PDF), it can be self-hosted via Docker or pip, and data can stay entirely on the user's own hardware, so leaving is plausible. However, no evidence shows an actual export feature for data Khoj itself creates, such as chats, agents or automations. Missing for 10: a documented data-export function, open-format export of chat history, agents and automations, an account-deletion or migration path for Khoj Cloud users, and independent hands-on confirmation of a clean exit.
